utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me over that fan?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just about. Whose new car's that in the car park? Taking up a very generous interpretation of one space.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with more primer than paint.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, the two-tone executive model.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Never mind the car, the coffee machine in the canteen's still broken. Just an observation, before anyone gives me that as a job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The hot water tasted better than the coffee anyway.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got a walking weekend planned and the weather looks absolutely grim. Broken coffee machine's really setting the mood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Well, it's only Tuesday, 20 October. Plenty of time for the forecast to get worse.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's the motivational bit of the meeting done, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Finished work first, then what's actually going on the list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the compressor one on Tuesday—this morning, I mean. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, closed, not another inspection today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same here: signed off the inspection on the gas turbine one on Tuesday, earlier this morning. All finished.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we finished the repair on the GT2 inlet valve last night. That's a completion update, not something still waiting.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, that was the one I thought was still open. Good.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Those are all in the done column, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I saw the pressure on the Line 3 Chiller dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Stayed back up, or was it hunting?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Stayed back up while I was there. Just passing on what I saw, not raising a repair.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Similar observation here: saw the pressure on the palletizer dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Nothing ongoing to report.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observations only. Neither of those is a new job from this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the line 2 interlock, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: So that remains blocked, not something we're pretending we can finish today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the trucks. Same uncertainty as before.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no confirmed delivery in the schedule. It's still a blocker, not a booked slot.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Those stay as blocked items.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the relief valve. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Tomasz Nowak owns that. The relief valve permit and isolation come first.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take it. No point putting the other bits ahead of that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Tomasz, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the feedwater pump tomorrow morning? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the feedwater pump tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just to keep that straight: relief valve first because production's held up; feedwater pump sign-off is top priority tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Those two aren't getting muddled together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There's also a site visit at the substation with the contractor needing doing by Thursday. Lower down the pile—if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll do a site visit at the substation with the contractor by Thursday. I can take that as the lower-priority one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tom. By Thursday, but not ahead of those priority jobs.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's fine. A spare-minute job, but Thursday still stands.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you run a function test on the line 2 guard by Wednesday, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run a function test on the line 2 guard by Wednesday. Fit that in when I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—just keeping the names separate. The blocked parts item I mentioned is the line 2 interlock.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, understood. I've accepted the line 2 guard function test, not the blocked interlock work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Easy to lose that distinction when Teams chops half a sentence off.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: While we're on the quieter stuff, I'll sort the training records for the new starters by the end of the week. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Olumide Adeyemi. Training records with you, by the end of the week, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep. It's the records I'm sorting, not adding any training sessions.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can I give you the monthly fire alarm test this afternoon as well? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Not that one, sorry. I haven't got the capacity this afternoon. I can keep the records, but I can't take the fire alarm test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Dave, can you take it instead—run the monthly fire alarm test this afternoon? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that instead. I'll run the monthly fire alarm test this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, that's a handover, not two people down for the same test.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: One of me's quite enough, according to most people.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll order spare parts for the pick and place on two by Wednesday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus. Spare parts for the pick and place on two with you, by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll get the order in. We're talking ordering the spares, not promising a repair.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it. Wednesday is the order deadline, not a delivery date.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's the agreed work. The line 2 interlock parts and the trucks delivery are still blockers; no extra chasing job being handed out here.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Correct. Nothing's magically arrived while we've been talking.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Neither has any sunshine, judging by that window. My weekend plan might just become sitting in a pub.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: A robust weather contingency. Sound engineering.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this turns into a design review of the pub—thanks, everyone. That's us.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
